name: The Pacific Securities Co., Ltd
summary: The Pacific Securities Co., Ltd engages in the securities business in China. It operates through Securities brokerage business, Credit business, Securities investment business, Investment banking operations, Asset management business, and other segments. The company provides securities brokerage, securities investment consulting, securities investment fund sales, agency sales of financial products, margin trading, and IB introduction activities; margin financing and securities lending business, and stock pledge repurchase business; equity investment and fixed income investment business; stock underwriting and sponsorship business, enterprise bonds, corporate bonds, local government bonds and…
